fields.System.Title: INB-306 — Prefer consolidation with existing stock
fields.System.Description:
Story

As a warehouse manager, I want new stock put with existing stock of the same product, so
that we stop filling the warehouse with half-empty locations.

Acceptance criteria

  • - Given a location already holding the product with room, then it is preferred over an
  • empty location.
  • - Given the product is batch-tracked and the location does not allow batch mixing, then
  • consolidation is not suggested for a different batch.
  • - Given consolidation would breach FEFO picking order, then it is not suggested.
  • - Given no consolidation candidate, then the rule falls back to
  • [INB-305](INB-305-capacity-and-zone-rules.md).
  • - Given the change, then locations-holding-stock versus locations-available is
  • measurable before and after.

Traceability

| Aspect | Detail |
|---|---|
| Modules | inbound, inventory |
| Tables | putaway_task, stock_balance, location |
| Risks | Consolidating batches so FEFO can no longer be honoured ([doc 09 §4.1](../../../docs/09-defect-hotspots.md)) |
| Tests | unit · integration |
